Container.Name: gutter-server
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted comic library server for the Gutter comic reader on iPad and iPhone.
Point it at a folder of CBZ/CBR comics laid out as one folder per series. It scans them, serves pages and covers, and syncs reading progress between your devices. It also serves an OPDS catalog and KOReader sync.
Set a password before the first start. Your library is mounted read-only by default, so Gutter never changes your files. Open the WebUI to watch the first scan, then add http://[your server]:8081 in the Gutter app.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: comics comic cbz cbr reader ipad opds koreader gutter

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web status page, admin console and the API the Gutter app talks to.

Config.Name: Comics
Config.Description: Your comics: one folder per series, CBZ/CBR files inside. Read-only by default. Change to read/write only if you turn on writeback.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database, covers, cache and the optional config.yaml.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Required. Sign in with any username and this password, in the WebUI and in the Gutter app.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for scripts (Authorization: Bearer).

Config.Name: ComicVine API key
Config.Description: Optional. Adds live metadata lookups. See docs/CONFIG.md.

Config.Name: Scan interval
Config.Description: How often to rescan the library, like 30m or 6h. off means manual scans only.

Config.Name: Writeback
Config.Description: true writes ComicInfo.xml into your files and converts CBR to CBZ. Also set the Comics path to read/write. Back up first.
